s1.quote: at a depth between 10 and 30 metres (33 and 98 ft)

s2.quote: one needs first an advanced Open Water Certification card to qualify

summary.text: A decommissioned Omani navy ship sunk as an artificial reef off Muscat in 2003, lying at roughly 10-30 m. It is a popular wreck dive that calls for Advanced Open Water certification and attracts plenty of marine life.
